verdict.rationale: Codex is a coding-agent/CLI/cloud tool for running tasks against repos, MCP servers, and connectors—there is no evidence of a shared knowledge-base/workspace feature aggregating docs and repos as a persistent team source of truth (distinct from RBAC on API/org access or per-repo setup config). Missing for 10: any workspace/knowledge-hub feature, ability to ingest docs alongside repos, and evidence of a persistent shared source-of-truth artifact for a team.
